name: Xandire's Truthseekers
inspire: After a Power step, if any friendly fighters (excluding Taros) are slain, Inspire each friendly fighter.

reactions.name: Raptor's Eye
reactions.rulesText: After another friendly fighter Moves, push a friendly Taros up to 3 hexes. After this push, Taros must be within 2 hexes of that fighter.

reactions.name: Seeker's Strike
reactions.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly fighter's successful melee Attack if the target was on a feature token.
reactions.rulesText: Flip that feature token. You can only use this ability once per battle round.

abilities.name: Blaze of Light
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step if your leader ({icon:leader}) is on the battlefield.
abilities.flavorText: The Lantern Astrala blinds and disorients the impure.
abilities.rulesText: Enemy fighters' weapons have -1 Attack dice in the next turn. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Blazing Purity
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after your leader ({icon:leader}) is slain.
abilities.flavorText: In a last burst of holy light, Calthia seeks to aid her fellow warriors.
abilities.rulesText: Pick up to 2 friendly fighters and heal each fighter, or pick 1 friendly fighter and heal that fighter twice instead. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Blazing Force
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly Dhoraz is slain.
abilities.flavorText: Even as he falls, Dhoraz exhorts his companions to greater deeds.
abilities.rulesText: Pick up to 2 friendly fighters and push each fighter 1 hex, or pick 1 friendly fighter and push that fighter up to 2 hexes instead. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Blazing Reprisal
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly Luxa is slain, before removing them from the battlefield.
abilities.flavorText: Though her demeanour is often mistaken as cold and uncaring, Luxa's will to aid her comrades burns hot.
abilities.rulesText: That fighter Attacks with a ranged weapon (excluding Upgrades). You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Four Stormcast-style warriors: three sturdy 5-health fighters who move slowly, plus Taros, a fast, flying but fragile minion. Raptor's Eye drags Taros along behind allies' Moves, while Seeker's Strike flips feature tokens when they land melee hits on enemies standing on them. The warband only Inspires once a fighter other than Taros falls, and each veteran's death triggers a parting heal, push or shot. It wins through steady, resilient brawling and objective control, getting stronger as its losses mount.
